description: This Dart source file defines an immutable data model class named 'Doctor', representing a doctor's domain model in a healthcare Flutter frontend application. It includes fields for id, name, specialty, and email, along with methods for JSON serialization, deserialization, and copying instances with modifications.

classes.name: Doctor
classes.description: Immutable class representing a healthcare professional with attributes such as id, name, specialty, and email.

methods.name: Doctor.fromJson
methods.description: Factory constructor to create a Doctor instance from a JSON map, extracting id, name, specialty, and email fields.

methods.name: Doctor.toJson
methods.description: Serializes the Doctor instance to a JSON-compatible map.

methods.description: Creates a copy of the Doctor object with optional modifications to its fields.
